How can I access the value of the ELBO through the rstan interface? I would like to compare runs of ADVI from different initialisations.

I believe that information is not returned to R. I guess you could capture the output and parse the last ELBO value.

Ben

we write the the whole elbo trajectory into an output file (empty by default, optional on cmdStan).
